hero.body: Bodywork that meets you where you are — and moves you past what's been holding you back. Whatever the limitation or challenge, we work it from every angle.

cards.title: Hands-On Bodywork
cards.body: Direct physical contact that locates and releases what's stuck. Structural, energetic, and intuitive — guided entirely by what your body communicates in the moment.

cards.title: Hands-Off Energy Work
cards.body: No touch required. Energetic bodywork works at a distance — online or in person — addressing limitations and challenges at the level where they originate.

cards.title: Classes & Group Work
cards.body: Guided group sessions that teach you to work with your own system. Movement, energy awareness, and nervous system tools you can apply long after the class ends.

about.label: About Matthew
about.body_1: I came to this work through my own body's demands. What I discovered is that limitations — physical, energetic, or mental — respond to the right kind of contact. Sometimes that's hands-on. Sometimes it's hands-off. The approach follows what your system actually needs.
about.body_2: Sessions are available in Austin and online worldwide. Whatever the challenge, we find the way through it.
about.quote: Hands-on or hands-off bodywork to change any limitation or challenge.

items.title: In Person — Austin, TX
items.body: Sessions held in Austin. The most immersive way to work — hands-on energetic bodywork in a quiet, focused setting designed to let your system fully land.

items.title: Online — Anywhere
items.body: Distance is not a barrier to energetic work. Online sessions are available worldwide for those outside Austin, or who prefer the convenience of home.

items.text: After one session with Matthew I slept better than I had in months. Something genuinely shifted that I hadn't been able to access through any other recovery method.
items.name: Runner, Austin Marathon

items.text: His classes are unlike anything I've done. I came for the physical recovery work and stayed for everything else it opened up.
items.name: Yoga teacher & performer

items.text: I was skeptical about online sessions but the work translated completely. The regulation I feel after our calls is real and lasting.
items.name: Cyclist, training remotely

cta.label: Ready to begin
cta.body: Bring all of your limitations, challenges, and questions — and let's see what's possible.
